class.name: OcgAspectGenid
class.brief_description: This class permits the creation and control of integer identifiers.
class.description: ! This class permits the creation and control of integer identifiers.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an available set of identifiers with the lower bound 0 and the upper bound INT_MAX / 2.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates an available set of identifiers with specified range. Raises IdentDefinitionError if theUpper is less than theLow.

method.name: Free_1
method.description: Free all identifiers - make the whole range available again.

method.name: Free_2
method.description: Free specified identifier. Warning - method has no protection against double-freeing!

method.name: HasFree
method.description: Returns true if there are available identifiers in range.

method.name: Available
method.description: Returns the number of available identifiers.

method.name: Lower
method.description: Returns the lower identifier in range.

method.name: Next_1
method.description: Returns the next available identifier. Warning: Raises IdentDefinitionError if all identifiers are busy.

method.name: Upper
method.description: Returns the upper identifier in range.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
